stem.en: Iron and zinc are placed in electrical contact in a moist environment. According to the electrochemical series, zinc is more easily oxidised than iron. Which metal corrodes preferentially, and why?
stem.et: Raud ja tsink on niiskes keskkonnas elektrilises kontaktis. Elektrokeemilise pingerea järgi oksüdeerub tsink kergemini kui raud. Kumb metall korrodeerub eelistatult ja miks?

label.en: Zinc corrodes preferentially, since it more readily loses electrons and is oxidised, protecting the iron in the process
label.et: Tsink korrodeerub eelistatult, kuna see kaotab kergemini elektrone ja oksüdeerub, kaitstes selle käigus rauda

label.en: Iron corrodes preferentially, since it is the less reactive of the two metals
label.et: Raud korrodeerub eelistatult, kuna see on kahest metallist vähem reaktiivne

label.en: Both metals corrode at exactly the same rate regardless of their position in the electrochemical series
label.et: Mõlemad metallid korrodeeruvad täpselt sama kiirusega, sõltumata nende asukohast elektrokeemilises pingereas

label.en: Neither metal corrodes, since electrical contact between two metals always prevents corrosion
label.et: Kumbki metall ei korrodeeru, kuna kahe metalli elektriline kontakt takistab alati korrosiooni
